name: Semiconductor Dependency Index

supersedes.name: Semiconductor Fabrication Capacity
supersedes.authority: D-111, operator decision R. Batista Silva 2026-08-14
supersedes.retirement_ground: Physical capacity cannot be robustly measured without violating unit rules (ETO refusal). Dependency maps directly to sovereignty exposure. SFC retired.

sources_refused.source: OECD Geographical Distribution of Wafer Fabrication Capacity
OECD Vulnerabilities in the Semiconductor Supply Chain
CSET/ETO Advanced Semiconductor Supply Chain Dataset
sources_refused.verdict: REFUSED TWICE: unit is in refused_units, and the source documents HQ-of-ultimate-parent keying and lists physical-location assessment as not recommended
ADMISSIBLE BUT PAID. Procurement refused by the operator 2026-08-14

definition: Net import dependency on semiconductors and electronic integrated circuits, normalised to a 0-100 stress scale where 100 is maximum dependency. Measures whether a state can obtain chips without another state, which is the exposure the retired capacity axis was a proxy for.
what_it_cannot_see: Import dependency cannot distinguish a state that imports by choice from one that imports because it cannot fabricate. A state hosting foreign-owned fabs that export output reads as low dependency for a reason this axis does not observe. Ships in the uncertainty ledger, never as a footnote.

licence_posture.finding: UN Comtrade data is UN copyright, internal use only, and may not be re-disseminated in any form without written permission of UNSD.
licence_posture.conflict: QESIS+ serves a public index under CC-BY-NC. Serving Comtrade values is redistribution.
licence_posture.precedent: The licence block already reads: TeleGeography-derived cable material is published only as derived aggregates, never raw. Same treatment applies.
rules: No raw Comtrade record reaches any served surface or either repository (OBL-1).
Serve one normalised 0-100 score per state, from which trade values cannot be reconstructed.
Raw records stay outside the repo under .gitignore; record query params, retrieval date and a SHA-256 of the payload so derivation is reproducible without republishing the input.
Attribution wherever the axis appears: Derived from UN Comtrade, United Nations Statistics Division.
Rate-limit the ingest to the free tier. Breaching it is a licence matter, not an engineering one (OBL-2).
licence_posture.escalation: OBL-3. Seek UNSD confirmation before any paid tier includes this axis. COUNSEL is not a lawyer.

ingestion_contract.aggregate_rows_refused: A row naming anything that is not an entity in the sample is refused. EU, ASEAN and World cannot stand in for their members.
ingestion_contract.reexport_caveat: Entrepot economies re-export at high volume. Net balance, never gross imports, or Singapore and the Netherlands read as self-sufficient.

big_gate.rule: Publishable only when at least 75 percent of the frame carries an admitted value. Below that, withheld with cause per state, never imputed (D-007).

coverage.note: EXPECTED, NOT MEASURED. No Comtrade record has been retrieved. Stated as expectation because asserting coverage before ingest is the D-101 pattern.

calibration.note: No anchors until real values exist. Anchors are part of the result, never a setting (fsqca.calibration.declared_because).

composite_weight.note: Undecided. Adding an axis changes every composite, so it does not enter the weighted sum until ingest and calibration close. HUMAN decides.
